records.text: The CIA approaches selected students at BYU's Hawaii and Jerusalem campuses about working for the agency.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep rupRLXmSndU)

appearances.snippet: I am saying they pluck from students and their Hawaii campus in particular, again, I'll have more information for you on this. ... They pull people out of the pool of Hawaii and in Jerusalem in particular, they approach students because they are the cream of the crop. ... they approach them about working for the CIA.

verification.notes: Open CIA recruiting at BYU in Provo is documented, but no reliable source was found for the anonymous claim that selected students at BYU-Hawaii or the BYU Jerusalem Center are approached for CIA service. The campus-specific and selection-mechanism details cannot be confirmed or directly contradicted.

sources.relevance: Documents general intelligence-agency recruiting at BYU Provo, not the alleged BYU-Hawaii or Jerusalem approach.

records.text: Candace Owens said records showed Jennifer Faumuina playing basketball at a private school in Hawaii in 2003 and later graduating from Weber State University in criminal justice in 2008.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In 2003, we found her playing basketball at a private—a private school in Hawaii. From there, she moved to Ogden, Utah, where she studied criminal justice, graduating from Weber State University, which was founded by the Mormon Church in 2008.

verification.notes: A 2003 Honolulu Star-Bulletin record confirms a Jennifer Faumuina played basketball for Sacred Hearts Academy, a private Hawaii school. The reviewed sources did not independently confirm that the same person graduated from Weber State in criminal justice in 2008. The compound citation is therefore only partially supported.

sources.title: Honolulu Star-Bulletin High School Beat - April 18, 2003
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous sports record lists Jennifer Faumuina on Sacred Hearts Academy's basketball team.

sources.title: Honolulu Star-Bulletin Girls Basketball All-Stars - 2003
sources.relevance: Lists Jennifer Faumuina as a Sacred Hearts basketball honorable mention.
